anchor: v1::Kai Halvorsen. The down jacket from ORD-20633 is too big. Can I swap it for a medium?

result.text: Your size swap is started: return RMA-20633 is open for the Alpine down jacket with no restocking fee. I can't place new orders with my tools, so please order the medium on the site. Under our exchange policy, the replacement ships once the warehouse scans the return. The return system lists a $229 refund after the jacket arrives, so I'd check with the order confirmation to make sure you're not charged twice.

results.title: Exchanges
results.body: Footwear and apparel can be exchanged for a different size or color within 30 days of delivery at no cost. To exchange, start a return with reason "wrong_size" and place a new order; the replacement ships once the return is scanned.

output.refundTiming: 5-7 business days after the item reaches the warehouse
